about.title: About Us
about.body: Huandao News is a Taiwan-focused news and lifestyle site. We believe news is more than breaking headlines — it is a tool for understanding daily life. From politics and society to travel and food, we go around the island with you.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: News tips, partnerships, and press release submissions are welcome. We will get back to you as soon as possible.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body: Huandao News respects your privacy. We collect and use data only to the minimum extent necessary to provide our services, and we do not share your personal data with third parties. This policy will be updated as our services evolve.
